messages:
ops-lead: Heads up — rolling kernel + BMC update across APAC edge pools Tue 03:00-07:00 SGT. Affects apac-edge-1 and apac-edge-2. Plan: cordon -> drain -> reboot -> uncordon. Target ~10% capacity lost per 15m cohort, ~8 cohorts total.
carla-sre: Any expected SLA impact for Hosted API or Dedicated reserved customers?
ops-lead: Hosted API should remain online; traffic will route to EU/US warm pools. Expect short p95 spikes (~20-100ms) and a few 429s for latency-sensitive tenants. Canary cohorts first, then ramp.
marco-capacity: Quick capacity recap: apac-edge-1 = 120 GPUs, apac-edge-2 = 80 GPUs. Cohorts sized at 12 GPUs each. Dedicated burst customers may see queueing; estimate 4-6% throughput dip per cohort without mitigation.
tj-eng: KV cache worry — draining might drop prefix/KV caches. Any warmup plan?
ops-lead: Yes — post-reboot we run a warmup job to reload hot prefixes. Example internal warmup call below:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-warmup.redwood/api/v1/warm" -H "Authorization: Bearer $WARM_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gptx-7b","prefixes":["/health","/popular/prompts"]}'
```
ops-lead: Operational drain uses: `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120` and our prestop flushes the in-memory KV to redis before eviction.
oncall-night: I'll be oncall for the window. Monitoring targets: pod_eviction_latency, host_recoveries, p95_token_latency, 5xx error rate. Escalate at >5% errors or >2min pod recreate lag.
devops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: https://internal-ops/maintenance/6298765432 • Reminder at 02:30 SGT • Customer notify set for APAC affected tenants.
sre-manager: Cost note — routing burst to US warm pools will add ~USD 2.4k in extra GPU-hours if we keep dedicated capacity. Suggest enabling spot fallback + q4_0 quantized variants for noncritical routes to reduce spend.
ops-lead: Agreed. Enable spot fallback and quantized model variant for best-effort/non-prod routes. Critical tenants keep priority on warm pools via routing policy.
carla-sre: Can you draft a one-line customer-facing status for status.redwood.io? Need ETA and impact summary.
ops-lead: Draft posted to #customer-success: "Planned maintenance in APAC edge (03:00-07:00 SGT). You may see brief latency spikes; no expected downtime for hosted API. We are routing traffic to warm pools and will monitor closely." Tagging @cs-team.
oncall-night: :thumbsup: I'll run the runbook check at 02:45 SGT and confirm dashboards green before rolling.
ops-lead: Thanks—team ready. Rolling starts Tue 03:00 SGT. Please react with :white_check_mark: if you have no blockers.
